why.title: Why Aster
why.w1b: Install it on a phone or PC. Marks and plans work without internet.
why.w2b: Switch any time. Students get plain, friendly wording.
why.w3b: Data stays on your device. Optional AI only sees topics and percentages, never names.
why.w4b: Topics, batches, fees and WhatsApp reminders, not a heavy school system.

faq.title: Questions
faq.q1a: In this demo everything is stored only in your own browser. Nothing is uploaded. Use Export in Profile to keep a backup.
faq.q2a: Solo is free for up to 60 students. Plus and Pro are planned, and the prices shown are demo prices.
faq.q3a: Yes. Once opened, the app and your data work offline. Only the optional AI needs internet.
faq.q4a: Only if you turn it on. Anonymised topic data is sent, never student names or phone numbers.
faq.q5a: Not in the demo. Later, students will join a class with a code from their teacher.

about.title: What is Aster?
about.body: Aster is a simple app that shows tutors, centers and schools which students and topics need help, so every class is spent on what matters. It works on any phone or PC, even offline.
about.ai: Optional AI will write a short summary of how a class or a student is doing and suggest what to do next. It only sees topics and percentages, never names or phone numbers. Coming soon.
